metrics.label: Unclear claim
metrics.definition: A proposition, its subject or scope remains unclear.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Scope overreach
metrics.definition: A conclusion exceeds the population, setting or task actually described in this abstract.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Certainty mismatch
metrics.definition: Certainty or hedging conflicts with the design, results or uncertainty described in this abstract.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Result and interpretation blur
metrics.definition: An observation, explanation, speculation or recommendation is presented without a recoverable distinction.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Progression problem
metrics.definition: The sentence sequence loses the main purpose, makes an unexplained jump or contains a digression.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Weak or unsupported ending
metrics.definition: The ending merely repeats its setup, makes a generic importance claim or adds an unsupported conclusion.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Unclear actors and actions
metrics.definition: Subjects and verbs obscure who or what acts, where the distinction matters.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Nominalization burden
metrics.definition: Action nouns obscure available actors or verbs. Necessary technical nouns are not defects.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Processing burden
metrics.definition: Clause structure or repeated sentence shapes impede comprehension of the relation expressed.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Redundancy
metrics.definition: Wording or propositions can be removed without losing a claim, qualification, relation or necessary orientation.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Empty metadiscourse
metrics.definition: Announcements, previews or recaps delay substance without helping the reader recover a relation.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Inflated or vague evaluation
metrics.definition: Evaluative or novelty language exceeds the support supplied by the abstract.
metrics.anchors: 0 no issue observed; 1 isolated minor issue; 2 recurring or meaningful issue; 3 substantial issue affecting central content; 4 pervasive issue obstructing the abstract. Use null if the supplied abstract cannot support the judgment.

metrics.label: Sentence rhythm uniformity
metrics.definition: 0: strongly varied sentence functions and rhythms; 2: some recurring shapes; 4: nearly every sentence follows the same rhythm or construction.
metrics.anchors: Use integers 0,1,2,3,4 between the stated anchors. These describe style, not a quality score. Use null if the judgment cannot be supported.

metrics.label: Rhetorical template strength
metrics.definition: 0: no recognizable stock sequence; 2: a recognizable but adapted abstract sequence; 4: rigid, interchangeable setup-method-result-importance scaffolding. A conventional sequence alone is not a quality defect.
metrics.anchors: Use integers 0,1,2,3,4 between the stated anchors. These describe style, not a quality score. Use null if the judgment cannot be supported.

metrics.label: Stock academic phrasing
metrics.definition: 0: concrete and task-specific phrasing throughout; 2: a mixture of specific language and conventional phrases; 4: pervasive stock or interchangeable academic phrases. Do not estimate language-model perplexity.
metrics.anchors: Use integers 0,1,2,3,4 between the stated anchors. These describe style, not a quality score. Use null if the judgment cannot be supported.

metrics.label: Content specificity
metrics.definition: 0: only generic topic and value statements; 2: a named method or system with some concrete results; 4: specific design, entities, quantities and bounded findings throughout.
metrics.anchors: Use integers 0,1,2,3,4 between the stated anchors. These describe style, not a quality score. Use null if the judgment cannot be supported.

metrics.label: Conceptual density
metrics.definition: 0: few distinct recoverable ideas or relations; 2: moderate new information per clause; 4: nearly every clause advances a distinct substantive relation. Jargon alone does not raise the score.
metrics.anchors: Use integers 0,1,2,3,4 between the stated anchors. These describe style, not a quality score. Use null if the judgment cannot be supported.

metrics.label: Qualification density
metrics.definition: 0: essentially unqualified assertions; 2: several explicit conditions, caveats or modal restrictions; 4: nearly every central claim is restricted or qualified. Judge amount, not adequacy.
metrics.anchors: Use integers 0,1,2,3,4 between the stated anchors. These describe style, not a quality score. Use null if the judgment cannot be supported.

metrics.label: Narrator prominence
metrics.definition: 0: impersonal description with no authorial presence; 2: author or study actions appear several times; 4: the authors and their actions dominate the presentation. First person is neither required nor inherently problematic.
metrics.anchors: Use integers 0,1,2,3,4 between the stated anchors. These describe style, not a quality score. Use null if the judgment cannot be supported.

metrics.label: Explicit discourse connections
metrics.definition: 0: relations between sentences are mostly left implicit; 2: some relations are explicitly signaled; 4: almost every rhetorical move is named or connected explicitly. Judge amount, not quality.
metrics.anchors: Use integers 0,1,2,3,4 between the stated anchors. These describe style, not a quality score. Use null if the judgment cannot be supported.

scope: Twelve adapted checks from the original framework plus eight prespecified descriptive LLM ratings. These are provisional operational judgments, not validated psychometric scales.
